Alice (AE): Quick sync — FinTechCo is asking for a short POC to validate a customer-support summarization flow and throughput under peak trading hours. They want results in ~4 weeks.
Priya (SE): Got it. Can we confirm success criteria? accuracy/ROUGE threshold, latency P95, and cost per 1k interactions?
Alice (AE): They care about latency < 300ms P95 for single-turn summaries, availability 99.9% during trading window, and unit cost below $0.06 per 1k tokens.
Marco (CISO): Security checkpoints first — can we run in their VPC or do we need on-prem? They will want KMS and audit logs.
Ben (Infra): We can support VPC/private deployment with KMS + audit. On-prem is possible but adds 2–3 weeks to setup.
Priya (SE): For technical scope: use cases = short single-turn summaries (avg 350 tokens in, 70 tokens out), batching allowed for background jobs, interactive mode must be near real-time. Need an eval set of ~500 representative chats.
Priya (SE): Suggested success criteria: 1) Summary ROUGE-L >= 0.62 vs labelled set, 2) P95 latency < 300ms at 50 concurrent interactive users, 3) cost <= budget target.
Ben (Infra): Capacity sketch: assume 50 concurrent interactive users, avg 500 tokens/request roundtrip (in+out+overhead) and 0.6 requests/min/user peak -> ~50 * 0.6 * 500 = 15k tokens/min = 900k tokens/hr.
Ben (Infra): GPU sizing: for a 70B model quantized to int8 on H100 we estimate ~550 tokens/sec per GPU for low-latency single-turn; need 28 GPUs to hit 15k tok/min with room for headroom. With batching tolerance (background), can drop to ~12 GPUs.
Priya (SE): Quick calc we usually share in presales:```
# assumptions
concurrency = 50
requests_per_min_per_user = 0.6
avg_tokens_per_request = 500
tokens_per_min = concurrency * requests_per_min_per_user * avg_tokens_per_request
# tokens_per_min = 15000
```
Alice (AE): Budget check — customer has an initial POC budget of $60k for infra+engineering for 4 weeks. Can we give a ballpark infra-only?
Ben (Infra): Infra-only: H100 reserved short-term pricing + managed control plane -> rough estimate $35k–$45k for 4 weeks at 12–28 GPUs (depends on batching + prewarming). Add SW integration + security on top.
Marco (CISO): Security questionnaire — I'll send the standard FinTech vendor form. Can you confirm Redwood Private supports per-tenant audit trails and CMK?
Priya (SE): Yes: per-tenant audit logs, KMS CMK support, and we can enable detailed token-level logging (redacted) for the POC. We'll need an IP allowlist and SSO SAML config from them.
Priya (SE): Action items: 1) FinTech to provide eval set (500 samples) and security questionnaire — Marco, please share by Mon. 2) We (SE+Infra) to produce a runbook with GPU sizing options and a cost sheet by Wed. 3) Sales to confirm acceptance criteria and budget alignment.
Marco (CISO): Sharing questionnaire now (link). Also we need an audit of data residency — can you confirm data stays in customer VPC for Private deployment?
Ben (Infra): Confirmed for Private: data does not leave customer VPC, control plane connects via customer-managed peering and logs back to their SIEM.
Alice (AE): I will draft the SOW and include 2 options: conservative (12 GPUs + canary latency tradeoffs) and high-throughput (28 GPUs) with estimated costs. Sending draft by EOD Tue.
JiraBot: Created ticket SALES-4321 "FinTechCo POC - scope & infra estimates" assigned to Priya, Ben.
Priya (SE): One more ask: can they provide peak concurrency windows (exact hours)? that helps batching policy and autoscale rules.
Alice (AE): I'll ask them in the call tomorrow at 10am PST.
Marco (CISO): Thanks — will push the security document and expected timeline after the call.
Priya (SE): Great. If they accept, we'll run an initial smaller smoke test (2 GPUs) for functional validation before scaling.
Alice (AE): Perfect. Marking follow-ups and will update thread after the call. :thumbsup:
